# Key Facts: Wayfarer Travel Insurance

Northwind Assurance Ltd

Issued: 10 November 2026

## 1 About this policy

Wayfarer Travel Insurance from Northwind Assurance Ltd covers illness and injury on a trip abroad, and loss of or damage to your belongings. Please read this document before you buy.

## 2 Period of cover and who can apply

| Item | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Period of cover | 20 December 2026 – 5 January 2026 |
| Maximum age | 70 |
| Waiting period (cancellation cover) | 7 days |

You can buy this policy up to the age of 75.

The waiting period for cancellation cover is 14 days. A cancellation for a reason that arises within this period after you buy the policy is not covered.

## 3 What is covered

| Cover | Sum insured |
| --- | --- |
| Medical and repatriation expenses | $2,000,000 |
| Personal belongings | $3,000 |
| Personal liability | $1,000,000 |

Medical and repatriation expenses are covered up to $5,000,000.

The personal belongings excess is $750 a claim, and the most we pay for a single item is $500.

## 4 Premium

| Cover | Premium |
| --- | --- |
| Medical and repatriation expenses | $42 |
| Personal belongings | $13 |
| Personal liability | $5 |
| Total | $65 |

The premium is paid in full when you buy the policy.

## 5 Main exclusions

1. Loss or damage you cause on purpose
2. An illness you were being treated for before you left
3. An injury during a hazardous sport
5. Belongings left unattended or lost
